question.prompt: What characterizes 2 quantities that are directly proportional?

solutions.explanation:
When speed is constant, distance and time are directly proportional. For positive travel time,
\[
\frac{\text{distance}}{\text{time}}=\text{speed}
\]
is constant. A constant ratio is the defining property of directly proportional quantities, wherever the ratio is defined. Therefore the answer is A.
solutions.title: Identify the constant ratio
